card.title: You Owe Me a Miracle
card.instruction: Carry one past favor as sufficient reason to expect an impossible act in return, and present the exchange as perfectly fair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I covered your lunch yesterday. Bring back the ten minutes I spent queuing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That covers the sandwich. I'm only asking for my time back.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can queue for you today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thanks. Use that time to retrieve yesterday's minutes. Then we're square.

mechanism: A treats buying lunch as a debt repayable only by returning the actual time spent, refusing ordinary substitute favors as incomplete.
confusable: Unlike bargaining for an oversized but possible repayment, the requested return must remain literally impossible and presented as equivalent.
comparison: The time alternative distinguishes sandwich value from lost minutes; the moon alternative treats moving a celestial object as equivalent to moving furniture.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
